elements.description: This is a dynamic sound effect (sfx) rendered in bold, angular katakana characters against a stark black and white background. The text appears to be stylized with thick, geometric letterforms that create a sense of impact or explosion. The characters are white against black angular shapes, with dramatic diagonal lines and sharp edges cutting through the composition. The art style employs high contrast with no gradients or gray tones, using only solid black and white areas. The lettering has a blocky, constructed quality typical of manga sound effects, with clean edges and bold line weights. The overall composition suggests movement and force, with the angular black shapes creating dynamic negative space around the white text. The sfx dominates the frame with its bold presence, likely representing a loud sound or impact in the story.

The character's face is partially visible, showing one large eye with detailed shading and what appears to be fanged teeth or an open mouth. The art style uses bold black outlines with minimal hatching, relying primarily on screentone for shading effects. There are some sound effects or action lines visible on the left side of the panel, rendered in typical manga onomatopoeia style.

The background contains geometric shapes and panels that appear fragmented or broken, suggesting destruction or chaos, with various tones of gray screentone creating depth and texture throughout the scene.
